elaine: noticed a short surge of preemptions in asia-southeast1 around 01:20 UTC, embedding p99 climbed and a few API 5xxs during the same window. cost win but customer latency impact.

infra-bot: incident_detector: spot_interrupt_burst — region=asia-southeast1 pool=mixed-g6 cohort=hostgroup-7 evict_rate=0.058

mike: yep saw that on grafana. looks like a tight cohort issue ~01:18-01:28 UTC, not whole region.

shubham: raw eviction rate spikes are noisy. propose a new derived metric `spot_impact_score = alpha*evict_rate + beta*delta_p99 + gamma*queue_pressure` to capture real SLO risk.

nina: agree. thresholding eviction_rate alone generates pages. if we use spot_impact_score and only auto-mitigate when predicted_slo_prob > 0.06 we can avoid noise.

mike: mitigation flow suggestion (safe-first):
1) auto-hedge: increase hedge to 30% for affected mixed pool (ttl 30m)
2) drain low-priority embedding shards to dedicated warm on-demand nodes
3) if p99 breach is observed for >10m -> page infra oncall

joel: runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
# apply temporary hedge
rbctl pool set-hedge --pool mixed-g6 --region asia-southeast1 --percent 30 --ttl 30m --reason "auto-hedge:spot-impact"
# reroute low-priority embedding jobs
jobctl move --selector "type:embedding,priority:low" --to queue:dedicated-warm --apply
```

shubham: implementation notes: compute spot_impact_score as an EWMA over 10m windows, weight recent delta_p99 higher (0.6), normalize queue_pressure by max historical qlen, expose metric infra_spot_impact{region,pool}. Also expose infra_predicted_slo_prob via the metrics pipeline (lightweight predictor). Feature flag per-region.

mike: draft prometheus rule:
```
ALERT InfraSpotImpactPredict
IF infra_predicted_slo_prob{region="asia-southeast1",pool="mixed-g6"} > 0.06
FOR 5m
LABELS { severity="warning", team="infra" }
ANNOTATIONS { summary="Predicted embedding p99 SLO risk from spot churn in asia-southeast1" }
```

nina: quick cost estimate: 30% hedge on that pool for 30m increases that pool's short window cost ~+9%, global infra delta ~+0.7%. finance okay with this trade for p99 protection (cc @finance-team). Will add estimate to alert annotation.

elaine: add a cool-off: require predicted_slo_prob delta > 0.02 vs baseline and at least 45m since last auto-hedge in that region to avoid flapping.

mike: i'll add a synthetic replay test to CI to re-run the 01:10-01:40 trace and assert: alert fired -> hedging executed -> no page. will open PR later today.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: prometheus-rule/infra-spot-impact created in staging

joel: i'll update runbook doc with verification steps (how to check drains succeeded, how to revert hedge, when to escalate).

shubham: will implement the EWMA + predictor in the metrics pipeline under feature flag and instrument infra_predicted_slo_prob metric. will roll to asia-southeast1 first.

elaine: owners: mike (alerts + CI test), shubham (metrics + feature flag), joel (runbook), nina (cost annotation). Goal: cut pages from noisy spot churn by ~75% while keeping daily SLO risk <0.5%. :thumbsup:

nina: tagging finance for FYI (will add link to cost calc in PR).

mike: rolling to asia-southeast1 tomorrow 0300 UTC, us-east1 next week if green.

elaine: thanks all, tracking via PRs. closing thread for now.
